summary: Keep each GitHub repository observer's cursor version maps in the polling member's plugin database, <state>/plugins/github/github.sqlite3; observer.observed claims, which replicate to every member, keep only how far the observer has read (items_since and comments_since).

replay.detail: No claim is rewritten or replayed. Claims older builds wrote keep their whole cursor and stay valid.

schema.detail: The claims database schema and its version are unchanged. New local file <state>/plugins/github/github.sqlite3 (PRAGMA user_version 1, one table observer_cursors keyed by observer subject, one row per observer this member polls), created on first start. It never syncs and is not in a backup. A file the daemon cannot use, damaged or with a newer version, is renamed to github.sqlite3.set-aside-* beside it and replaced by an empty one; the daemon starts. A member drops an observer's row when the observer stops or another member declares it.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. No fleet barrier or coordinated upgrade: each member changes only its own writes.

compatibility.detail: Claim vocabulary (contract change C1): for github.repository observers (observer/github/*), observer.observed's cursor field holds only items_since and comments_since, not the version maps (seen, item_versions, comment_versions, identities, listing scans). The field and its type are unchanged, and older builds read the smaller cursor through the provider's serde defaults. No client-v0 change. Mixed versions need no barrier. An older poller keeps writing whole cursors until it upgrades. An upgraded member with no row for an observer polls from the cursor in that observer's newest observer.observed claim, then keeps a row, so it adopts a claim's cursor once per plugin database. A member that takes over polling, upgraded or older, reads on from the claim's read position: an issue closed or a comment written in the gap is delivered once, and items whose facts equal the recorded ones deliver nothing. An observer whose poll cannot keep its cursor is degraded with error code github-plugin-database.

downtime.detail: No startup migration beyond creating the plugin file. The first poll after upgrade continues from the cursor in the observer's newest claim.

manual.detail: No operator action on upgrade. A set-aside github.sqlite3.set-aside-* file may be deleted.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to an older build is supported. The older build reads the observer's folded actual state, whose cursor is the last read position this build recorded (or the last whole cursor an older build wrote), and reads on from there, delivering only what changed since the recorded facts. Older builds ignore the plugin file, which may be deleted.
